description:
AirPods desktop user experience enhancement program


1. Reduced idle CPU usage by pausing unnecessary BLE scanning, hidden animations and frequent polling, and by caching unchanged tray icons. Based on #199 by @aizuon, integrated and refined in #210.
2. Reworked low-latency audio to use a connection-aware low-bandwidth silence stream, with safer recovery, a synchronized tray toggle and regression tests. Proposed in #199 by @aizuon and extended in #210.
3. Added tray Quick Connect for reconnecting a selected paired Bluetooth audio device with one click. Originally proposed and implemented in #205 by @aaroncheungzy, then reviewed and hardened in #211.
4. Added AirPods Max (USB-C) support, including product ID detection, display naming, animation mapping and regression tests. Originally proposed and implemented in #197 by @chrolicious, then refined in #215.
5. Added Brazilian Portuguese (pt_BR). (#191, thanks @alexmartins) and refined in #209.
6. Added Italian (it_IT). (#202, thanks @RyoSaebaChan).
7. Added Ukrainian (uk_UA). (#182, thanks @andryua).
8. Refined the Korean translation to use more natural Apple-style wording. (#179, thanks @Resi-le).
9. Added Turkish (tr_TR). (#174, thanks @haskaan).
10. Added Bulgarian (bg_BG). (#172, thanks @m-chavalinov).
11. Added European Portuguese (pt_PT). (#129, thanks @kikosgc).
12. Synchronized all 13 translation catalogs with the current UI, translated the new Quick Connect strings, and completed or polished German, French, Japanese, Russian and Brazilian Portuguese. (#214 by @Kashionz, incorporating the translators credited above).
13. Fixed fresh-profile startup by creating the application data directory recursively, and prevented test binaries from being included in release packages.
🎉Birthday Editon! Cheers!
